scope: NBA full-game moneyline markets only, exact nba-TEAM-TEAM-YYYY-MM-DD slug; exclude WNBA, NCAA, props, futures, totals and handicaps. Gamma cached vol10k universe implies final-volume selection bias.

primary_period.note: Full 2024/25 season coverage; calendar split fixed before performance analysis. No threshold tuning.

v2_extension: Extract only mapped NBA tokens in V2 coverage from 2026-04-28 onward. Report separately as a coverage extension, not pooled primary inference because intervening 2025/26 histories are not guaranteed complete. No V2 forecast claims unless all selected games have complete fill coverage.
extraction: Pinned HF V1/V2 revisions; remote parquet token predicate and projected columns, cached NBA-only rows. Column chunks may contain non-NBA rows internally; do not download/save full universe files. Bound files by market creation/resolution overlap and record every partition scanned.

ledger.perspective: maker field only in each OrderFilled, including taker-order maker aggregate rows; never synthesize opposite taker row
ledger.v1_fees: BUY reduces received shares, SELL reduces collateral proceeds
ledger.v2_fees: BUY adds collateral cost; SELL reduces collateral proceeds
ledger.net_inventory: signed shares per wallet/token, strict chronological block/log replay
ledger.negative_policy: At signal t drop a wallet-market pair if either outcome inventory has ever fallen below -1e-6 up to t. For realised history drop if ever negative through resolution. Never use a future violation to clean an earlier primary signal. Also report full-path ever-negative counts and an explicitly ex-post-cleaned sensitivity (selection leakage disclosed).
ledger.pnl: cash flows through resolution plus remaining outcome shares at metadata payout, included once only after resolution timestamp < t. No transfers/splits/merges/redemptions/conversions/proxy mapping; histories are sample-period NBA PnL, not lifetime overall PnL.
ledger.resolution: Gamma closedTime proxy; no payout-finality proof. Use terminal 0/1 prices with tolerance 1e-4. Exclude ambiguous/void outcomes.

signal.probability: weighted mean of token0 inventory/(token0+token1 inventory); team0 rather than literal YES
signal.weight: positive past NBA PnL times total net outcome shares
signal.market_price: last observed execution on either outcome, translated to token0 probability, strictly at/before snapshot; report staleness; up to48h allowed, never future interpolation
signal.market_maker: as-of t, >=100 fills, buy and sell each >=25% of cumulative dollar volume, dollar turnover/(1+absolute cumulative net cashflow)>10; exclude. Behavior flag only, not known identity/intent.
signal.liquidity: traded dollar volume strictly before snapshot; tertile cutpoints fitted on train only

inference.cluster: unique game market, one outcome0 forecast per horizon
inference.BH: entire amended family; blocked tests conservatively p=1 for adjustment, display missing. Original83 ledger is preserved in archive, superseded by this amended family.
inference.primary_bootstrap: paired event bootstrap with centered two-sided null and percentile95% CI
inference.lag_search: joint game-level sign flips; max statistic across 1/6/24h
inference.persistence: training PnL frozen at split; future PnL measured over distinct test games including zero for inactive training wallets; no selecting only future survivors
inference.placebo: one matched alternative wallet per expert, without replacement where possible; match past activity and dollar-volume quintiles within current eligible holders; fixed seeds; no PnL qualification for placebo

economic: No order simulation. Observed historical spread only if source available. Otherwise report analytical break-even cost in cents and cost sensitivities 1/2/5/10c, no executable profit claim and no invented USD100 depth.
sanity: Deterministically choose8 addresses spanning training-PnL ranks; compare approximate NBA PnL to public NBA/overall leaderboard if served. Report signed/absolute error and noncomparable coverage, do not require match.
known_limitations: Causal negative-inventory exclusion cannot detect all missing flows
Partial category/sample-period PnL is not lifetime skill
Last execution is not midpoint or executable quote
Gamma closedTime is mutable and can lag sporting outcome
Resolution-aligned snapshots are ex-post evaluation clocks
Final-volume-filtered Gamma universe has selection bias
Explicit ex-post-cleaned sensitivity can have selection leakage
nonzero_panel: Retain all observed game-horizon rows, with missing expert fields if fewer than3 experts; actual tests use the declared eligible subset. Never substitute synthetic probabilities.
